entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I'm a bit lost. I have this order and I think I need to return it. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me a little more about the item? What specifically is the issue?

It's a helmet I bought. I got it as a gift for my nephew, but the color is all wrong for his bike. I just looked at it and the box is still unopened. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It sounds like a simple preference issue with the color, not a defect with the helmet itself, is that correct?
Yes, I think so. The website was a bit overwhelming. I just picked one. He needs a blue one, this one is red.
I understand. Let me pull up your order information. Do you have the order number handy?
Um, let me see... It's VF-8675309.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the AeroSafe helmet, placed 74 days ago. Let me just confirm our current policy.
Oh, 74 days? Is that bad? I told you I was confused by all this.
Not at all. I've checked our system, and for this item, VeloFit has a 90-day return window. Since you're at 74 days, you are well within the timeframe to make a return.
Oh, really? That's... that's a relief! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, that's perfect. We take helmet safety very seriously, so we can only accept returns on them in their original, unused condition. I'm processing the return for you now and will email you a prepaid shipping label. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac! You made that so easy. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything! Thank you again!
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
